messages:
Priya: Heads-up: we9re planning a staged rebuild of the staging base image next Wed. Requirement: attest and sign the final image artifact with the org KMS key before promotion. Need an RBAC microplan and audit logging checklist. Any immediate blockers?
Devon: Ack. Which KMS key and which service principal should get signing rights?
Priya: Key: kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/image-signer. Principal: image-builder@redwood-prod.svc (least privilege: sign-only).
Alex: For GCP, the proper role for cosign KMS signing is roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier on the specific cryptoKey. Don't grant any keyAdmin perms.
Sam: Vulnerability scan flagged glibc CVE-2024-XXXXX in one of the child layers. If we rebuild now it should pick up patched glibc. Can we move the rebuild earlier?
Priya: We can accelerate if the CI picks the fixed packages; still want a canary window (promote to canary staging, wait 48h, then prod).
Julia: CI snippet for cosign + KMS (drop into the sign step):

```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key "kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/image-signer" gcr.io/redwood/staging-base:${BUILD_TAG}
```

Also CI needs `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` on the key and `roles/storage.objectViewer` on the registry bucket to pull the image for signing.
Devon: I9ll scope the IAM binding to the single key resource in terraform (no list/delete perms). Will prepare a PR.
ci-bot: build queued for gcr.io/redwood/staging-base:20260401 6 id=8472
ci-bot: build finished: success (6m) 6 pushed to staging tag
Sam: After sign and push I9ll run the vuln scan and post a package-diff. If any criticals remain we hold the rollout.
oncall-sre: If the signing key is compromised or we need to revoke trust, how do we mark already-signed images as untrusted? We can9t remove signatures from images.
Priya: Plan: 1) Maintain allowlist of deployed image digests; runtime admission rejects digests not in allowlist. 2) If key compromise suspected, rotate key and update allowlist to exclude affected digests. 3) Expose key status in console and make rotation a documented emergency step.
Alex: For audit trails: enable KMS Admin audit logs (admin activity) and Data Access logs for storage writes. Sink KMS and storage logs to the security project with 365-day retention. Post the sink name once created.
Julia: Also add an automated verify step in the canary pipeline: `cosign verify --key <kms://...> gcr.io/...` and verify attestation JSON fields (build_id, git_sha, builder_sa).
Devon: I9ll include the terraform change + a minimal runbook for the SRE oncall on how to mark images untrusted and how to execute a key rotation emergency. PR target EOD.
Priya: Action items: Devon: terraform IAM binding + PR (EOD today); Julia: add cosign verify in canary pipeline (PR by tomorrow); Sam: post vuln diff after scan; Alex: confirm log sink name & retention and publish alert index; oncall-sre: sanity-check runtime deny/allowlist steps.
Priya: Thanks all 91d 6 reconvene if Sam finds a blocker.
